Changes:
1. Raw 12K guard now accepts nonempty explicit native_head_gguf OR native_preset,
   before normalization. Actual later native-head/phase checks remain in place.
2. Header-only host HeadUploadOwner is used by production NativeHead::load and
   existing CPU fixture. Allocation pointers, bytes, scratch bytes, original
   source shared ownership and uncertainty are explicit owner state. Submission
   uncertainty is set before upload or conversion callbacks can submit/throw.
   False copy or throwing submission/wait retains both device allocations and
   original CPU source, permanently denies retry/clear, and causes terminate
   before source-member destruction. NativeHead blocks load/run/release/reload
   while poisoned and exposes upload_state plus error pointer/count/status.
   Known pre-submission allocation false/throw safely cleans up and can retry.
   Existing gpu::free checked/fail-stop contract is retained.
3. Exact STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE=1 snapshots precisely the supported, checked raw
   GGUF output.weight payload into immutable shared CPU bytes BEFORE first H2D.
   Initial and reload upload use the same original bytes, type and dimensions.
   Reload never reopens a same-metadata changed file. No D2H head copy or
   additional default CPU payload buffer exists. Nonlease unknown upload retains
   original GgufModel mapping. Lease snapshot remains until safe owner destruction.
   Q6/Q8 conversion keeps existing kernels/layout. Lease initial and reload both
   use wait_and_throw; default retains q.wait. NativeEmbed is unchanged.
4. CPU fixture covers allocation 1/2 false and throw; known-complete ownership,
   duplicate stage rejection, cleanup and known-safe retry; snapshot first/reload
   after same-size source mutation; upload false/throw; conversion false,
   submission throw and completion throw; retained source weak ownership,
   allocation addresses/bytes, no cleanup/retry callbacks; subprocess destructor
   fail-stop before cleanup. Unknown fixtures exit children without destructors;
   no production recovery/test-only escape hatch exists. Linux fork required;
   non-Linux prints coverage skip. Existing target requires no CMake edits.
5. Caller drained-reader booleans remain the actual caller contract. False proof,
   duplicate release and reload-before-release are denied by source guards.
   Release additionally requires the retained opt-in snapshot. No broad proof
   framework or runtime pointer-type/VMM policing introduced.

Assumptions/limits:
Shared host helper models allocation/upload/conversion ownership, not provider
submission atomicity, real DMA, conversion parity or live GPU completion. GPU
copy true retains existing synchronous completion contract; false/throw has no
completion guarantee. Allocation failure before submission means no DMA occurred.
Immutable bytes bind the head payload at initial snapshot time; callers still
must prevent concurrent modification during the initial read/snapshot. They need
not keep the source file unchanged afterward for lease reload. CPU storage is
bounded by validated actual payload metadata, not a fixed guessed head size.
Requested memory counts, prefill/math/other flags, provider reserve and defaults
are unchanged. Source review is not a direct NativeHead API runtime fixture.
False-proof/reload-before-release live API and actual lease GPU qualification
remain Main checks. No fullcontext/logit/state/restore/quality/physical-fit proof.
No old receipts rewritten, no captures/traces created, no deletion/cleanup.
